sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: Mass 48 g, volume 6 cm³. Density and float?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 8 m is to be paved at $3 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $192; the cost is proportional to the area
$96; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$24; the cost is proportional to the area
$192; the cost is proportional to the side length

items.prompt: Find the volume of a rectangular prism 3 by 4 by 3. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a sphere cut by any plane that meets it in more than one point.
A solid object has mass 117 g and volume 9 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 12 m is to be paved at $2 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a square pyramid with base edge 11 and height 10. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
